section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1978
title: 29 Distribution of Suicides by Sex: During 1978, 60·0 percent of the total suicides were committed by males and 40·0 percent by females, in the country as well as in the States as a whole. The 'Male' and 'Female' ratio in suicides for the Union Territories as a whole was of 59·5 and 40·5 respectively, while for the Metropolitan Cities, it was 56·0 percent and 44·0 percent respectively. The percentage of male involvement in 11 States, 4 Union Territories and 4 Metropolitan Cities was higher than the all-India average of 60·0 percent. The details are presented in Table-VII.
